svg.text: Measurement architecture and scientific decision path
Eight linked validation layers connect physical observables to inference, replication, transport, and explicit stop rules.
The program is organized as a chain of questions, not a ladder of claims.
Each stage must pass its own mathematical and statistical gate before information can move downstream.

Scope boundary: analytic and synthetic validation of measurement machinery. No stage by itself constitutes empirical evidence that consciousness has been measured.
